label: Thinking of the next ten years, how financially secure do you feel? - Myofit sub-study
meta_rows: Thinking of the next ten years, how financially secure do you feel? - Myofit sub-study
Socioeconomic position. These variables need to be merged with those who have answered the questions in the 2023 Home visit.
cat_rows: This category contains data on the economic circumstances of the participant such as household income and benefit details, recorded by the 1946 birth cohort participants who took part in the Myofit (2020-2024) sub-study. Participants who were unable to do answer the questions during the 2023 Home visit were asked to when they took part in the Myofit (2020-2024) sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
